Manila Water strengthens its fire preparedness this Fire Prevention Month with the maintenance and readiness check of over 3,300 fire hydrants across the East Zone. 🚒💧
 
This includes purple hydrants that use treated wastewater—helping conserve drinking water while giving firefighters an additional supply for emergencies.
 
Working closely with the Bureau of Fire Protection and LGUs, Manila Water ensures that hydrants are visible, accessible, and fully functional, especially in dense and vulnerable communities where quick water access can prevent major damage.
 
Hydrant upkeep remains a year‑round commitment as part of Manila Water’s dedication to public safety and reliable service across the East Zone.
 
Read more: https://t.co/PtrdN4x6us
 
Safety flows where readiness begins.
 
#StaySafeKatubig #SerbisyongKatubig #FirePreventionMonth
